headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 22, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees suffered a 3-5 loss to the Detroit Tigers, with Amed Rosario leading the Yankees' offense with a home run and 2 RBI. Framber Valdez earned the win for the Tigers with 6 strong innings, striking out 8 batters. In other action, the Kansas City Royals secured a narrow 2-1 win over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Michael Wacha pitching 7.0 innings and allowing just 1 ER. The Texas Rangers secured a hard-fought 4-3 win over the Miami Marlins, with Ezequiel Duran leading the offense with a home run and two RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Blas Castaño, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right pectoral strain. Josh Ekness has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with a right calf strain. Liam Hicks has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 20, 2026, with a low back strain. Luis Severino has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with a right shoulder strain.

The Atlanta Braves have bolstered their rotation with the addition of right-handed pitcher Tyler Schoff, acquired from the Washington Nationals in a trade. The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Jayden Murray from the Houston Astros in exchange for first baseman Cameron Sisneros. The Arizona Diamondbacks have traded shortstop Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash.

top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a narrow win over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Michael Wacha pitching 7.0 innings and allowing just 1 ER. Alex Lange earned the save in the close contest.

top_news.title: **Rangers Edge Marlins in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a hard-fought 4-3 win over the Miami Marlins, with Ezequiel Duran leading the offense with a home run and two RBIs. Kumar Rocker impressed on the mound, striking out nine batters in five innings of work.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Phillies 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 4-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Foster Griffin earning the win after 7.1 innings of work. Curtis Mead led the Phillies' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Castaño Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-hander Blas Castaño has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right pectoral strain, effective retroactive to June 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Braves Bolster Rotation with Trade Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves have strengthened their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Tyler Schoff, acquired from the Washington Nationals in a trade.
